senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. next w.) [to be excited, noisy,] esp. (of the ass) to bray.
units: <cite ref="Berakhot 56a:14">Ib. 56ᵃ</cite> (in Chald. dict.) <he>דקאי אאיסדן ונוֹעֵר</he> standing at the head of the bed and braying.

<cite ref="Bava Kamma 18b">B. Kam. 18ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Kiddushin 24b">Kidd. 24ᵇ</cite>; a. e.—[<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 4:8:1">Cant. R. to IV, 8</cite> <he>בתחלה הוא נוער</he>, read: <cite ref="N00971"><he>נֵעוֹר</he></cite>, v. <cite ref="P00343"><he>עוּר</he></cite>.]
